rawContent: If you only notice rape cases when the rapist is Black, you’re right to call out the rapist each time but are obviously racist while at it. If you only participate in #MeToo for Depp and ignored the movement before and are making fun of Heard, you’re most likely a misogynist.
Thousands of men used the #MeToo hashtag for years yet for some reason those men have been invisible to you? 🤔
